<section class="r-lab" data-r-lab="05_predictor_checks" aria-label="Check temperature-year correlations and inspect VIF">
<div class="r-lab-heading"><span class="r-lab-badge">Run R</span><h3>Check temperature-year correlations and inspect VIF</h3></div>
<p class="r-lab-note">Recalculates annual correlations. Displays the saved brood-level VIFs; recalculating those VIFs requires the individual analysis records.</p>
<label for="r-code-05_predictor_checks">Editable R code</label>
<textarea id="r-code-05_predictor_checks" class="r-lab-code" spellcheck="false" rows="11">weather &lt;- read.csv(&quot;data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv&quot;)
samples &lt;- read.csv(&quot;tables/temporal_models_20261022/observed_annual.csv&quot;)
for (trait in c(&quot;clutch&quot;, &quot;fledging&quot;)) {
  years &lt;- samples$year[samples$trait == trait]
  a &lt;- weather[weather$year %in% years, ]
  cat(trait, &quot;seasons:&quot;, nrow(a), &quot;annual Pearson r:&quot;, cor(a$year, a$temp_mean), &quot;\n&quot;)
}
# These VIFs were calculated on the full brood-level fixed-design matrices.
# Annual aggregates cannot reconstruct the brood-level age/date design.
vif &lt;- read.csv(&quot;tables/predictor_diagnostics/fixed_design_vif.csv&quot;)
print(vif, row.names = FALSE)
</textarea>
